dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a parabolic curve that tapers from a broad base toward a posteriorly-recurved apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; lacks acute terminal points or squaring.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately steep convex slope, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum visible base width to vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and jagged tissue loss at the posterior-ventral margin near the trailing edge base. Presence of numerous small, circular white punctate marks across the dorsal skin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast white-to-light-gray ventral-posterior pigmentation patch visible on the lower flank.
